test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'RESET' is written as '36538540' and 'START' is written as '384013640'. How will 'STOP' be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is: 

**Twice the value of consonant whereas vowel is written as it is.**

 'RESET' is written as '36538540'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e9f404c7dbbf3ff586e582796594481e890754cbfa7a7d091b9a0bc5786d12b.png] 

And

'START' is written as '384013640'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/838172a8d4f2a4b50148467c0f27b49ae2c2b2aa8f30446ab7f33ef47981026b.png] 

Similarly, 

'STOP' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f68e656da1914e10d4df4fd891a8a6e1202c5fc64c4e3f3e2f4aa44e9aaf7aa.png] 

Hence, **'38401532**' is the correct answer.
